primary_endpoint: Change in MRI-measured hepatic fat fraction from baseline to Week 16.
efficacy_outcome: Hepatic fat fraction changes were −8.43% and −6.77% with BMS-986036 10 mg QD versus −1.26% and −1.35% with placebo (p=0.0004); and −6.45% and −5.20% with 20 mg QW versus the corresponding placebo values (p=0.0084).
safety_signal: AEs occurred in 18 participants (10 mg QD), 13 (20 mg QW), and 15 (placebo); SAEs in 1, 0, and 1, respectively. Injection-site reactions occurred in treated groups; no deaths or AE-related discontinuations were reported.
